propositions: When the completion verifier exhausts its search budget without finding evidence to refute any criterion, it currently fails; bounded-search exhaustion should trigger automatic resumption instead of requiring operator intervention
The resumption loop should sit at the shared close-gate verification seam (close_precheck._completion_precheck) so CLI, MCP, and library closes all exercise it uniformly

Auto-resume qualification must reuse the existing _insufficiency_only predicate unchanged, triggering only when every unmet criterion carries the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker with no genuine refutations present
Resumptions must be bounded by verify.auto_resume_max count and by progress condition: a resumption dispatches only when the prior attempt strictly increased the cache-credited PASS count
Each resumption attempt must be logged with attempt number, cache-credited criteria count, and remaining unmet count, surfaced in ticket trail and close output
After bounded resumptions exhaust without a PASS, the gate surfaces the existing failure with an explicit attempts-count message stating how many auto-resumes were attempted
